hero_headline: 妇产科要闻：复发性植入失败与CIN2管理共识同日更新
daily_overview: 今日两项指南更新：Fertility & Sterility发布复发性植入失败委员会意见，聚焦反复胚胎移植失败患者的诊断标准；GOCM发布2026版CIN2管理中国专家共识，为宫颈病变临床决策提供最新依据。

tech_briefs.title: Recurrent implantation failure: a committee opinion.
tech_briefs.summary: Fertility & Sterility发布复发性植入失败委员会意见，指出多次胚胎移植失败患者可能存在影响植入的潜在疾病，并回顾该病症的诊断标准。原文摘要未说明与既往建议的差异，但为生殖医学临床评估提供了权威参考。

tech_briefs.title: Chinese expert consensus on the management of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 (CIN 2) (2026 edition)
tech_briefs.source: GOCM · Gynecology and Obstetrics Clinical Medicine · Guidelines and Consensus
tech_briefs.summary: GOCM发布2026版CIN2管理中国专家共识。原文摘要未说明与既往建议的差异，作为中国专家共识更新，将影响宫颈上皮内瘤变二级病变的临床管理路径，需关注其具体推荐内容。

research.dailySignal: 今日共筛选出5篇达到阈值的研究，重点涉及从不平等梯度到优先带：将英格兰早产不平等转化为靶向普遍主义政策、Iparomlimab和tuvonralimab用于既往经治的宫颈癌患者、卵巢癌模型功能分析揭示Bcl-xL/NOTCH靶向可克服耐药。以下内容用于研究情报追踪，单篇论文结论不等同于指南建议。

papers.title: From inequality gradients to priority bands: Translating preterm birth inequalities into targeted universalist policy in England.
papers.abstract: Preterm Births (PTBs) are viewed as one of the major causes of neonatal morbidity, mortality and health-system cost in England. The incidence of preterm is persistently greatest among those experiencing socioeconomic and ethnic inequalities. This study aims to quantify deprivation and ethnicity gradients, using the available dataset, in PTBs and subsequently to translate deprivation-related inequality into policy-relevant priority bands. It analyses aggregated live-birth data for England (2020-2021), stratified separately by gestational age × Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD), and gestational age × maternal ethnicity. Socioeconomic inequalities are summarised using the Slope Index of Inequality (SII), Relative Index of Inequality (RII), deprivation-attributable excess cases, and the population attributable fraction (PAF) with the least deprived quintile as reference. Subsequently, a two-axis rule combining relative risk and share of excess burden is applied to derive the prioritised target bands. The data analysed comprises 1,179,195 live births in 2020-2021, demonstrating a monotonic increment across populations, from 6.39% in the least deprived quintile to 8.71% in the most deprived. The most deprived quintile accounted for 57.7% of deprivation-attributable excess PTBs. Differences across ethnic disparities were also evident, with the highest PTB rate being among Black Caribbeans (10.22%; RR 1.37 vs White British births). Translation of inequalities into deprivation-based priority bands provides an empirical bridge between surveillance and targeted universalist prevention policy, thus supporting proportionate resource allocation in high-burden populations.

summaryZh.titleZh: 从不平等梯度到优先带：将英格兰早产不平等转化为靶向普遍主义政策
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 量化英格兰早产（PTB）中剥夺与种族梯度，并将与剥夺相关的不平等转化为政策相关的优先带。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 基于汇总活产数据的生态/不平等分析研究
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 2020-2021年英格兰活产数据，共1,179,195例活产，按孕周×多重剥夺指数（IMD）和孕周×母亲种族分别分层。
summaryZh.methods: 使用斜率不平等指数（SII）、相对不平等指数（RII）、剥夺归因超额病例数和人群归因分数（PAF，以最不剥夺五分位为参照）总结社会经济不平等；随后应用结合相对风险和超额负担份额的双轴规则推导优先目标带。
summaryZh.keyResults: 早产率从最不剥夺五分位的6.39%单调递增至最剥夺五分位的8.71%；最剥夺五分位占剥夺归因超额早产的57.7%。种族差异方面，黑加勒比人群早产率最高（10.22%；与英国白人活产相比RR 1.37）。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 将不平等转化为基于剥夺的优先带，为监测与靶向普遍主义预防政策之间提供了经验桥梁，支持在高负担人群中按比例分配资源；但本研究为生态学分析，不应被解读为个体层面的因果或临床指令。

papers.title: Iparomlimab and tuvonralimab in previously treated patients with cervical cancer.
papers.abstract: Iparomlimab and tuvonralimab (QL1706) is a bifunctional antibody containing anti-programmed death-1 IgG4 and anti-cytotoxic T-lymphocyte antigen 4 IgG1. This multi-center single-arm phase 2 trial recruits patients with recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer (r/m CC) who have failed at least first-line platinum-based chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab. QL1706 is administered at a dose of 5.0 mg/kg every 3 weeks via intravenous infusion. The primary endpoint is objective response rate (ORR) per independent review committee (IRC). In a total of 148 patients, the confirmed ORR and disease control rate are 33.3% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 25.8%-41.6%) and 65.3% (95% CI: 57.0%-73.0%) per IRC, respectively. The median progression-free survival is 5.4 months (95% CI: 3.9-6.9). The median overall survival is 17.1 months (95% CI: 14.8 to not evaluable). Treatment-related adverse events occur in 107 (72.3%) patients. No treatment-related death occurs. QL1706 shows promising efficacy and is well tolerated in previously treated patients with r/m CC. The trial is registered at clinicaltrials.gov (NCT05557565).

summaryZh.titleZh: Iparomlimab和tuvonralimab用于既往经治的宫颈癌患者
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估Iparomlimab和tuvonralimab（QL1706）在既往经治的复发或转移性宫颈癌患者中的疗效和安全性。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 多中心、单臂、2期临床试验。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 148例复发或转移性宫颈癌患者，这些患者至少一线铂类化疗（联合或不联合贝伐珠单抗）治疗失败。
summaryZh.methods: QL1706以5.0 mg/kg剂量每3周经静脉输注给药。主要终点为独立审查委员会（IRC）评估的客观缓解率（ORR）。试验注册于clinicaltrials.gov（NCT05557565）。
summaryZh.keyResults: 经IRC评估，确认的ORR为33.3%（95%置信区间：25.8%-41.6%），疾病控制率为65.3%（95%置信区间：57.0%-73.0%）。中位无进展生存期为5.4个月（95%置信区间：3.9-6.9）。中位总生存期为17.1个月（95%置信区间：14.8至不可评估）。治疗相关不良事件发生107例（72.3%），无治疗相关死亡。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: QL1706在既往经治的复发或转移性宫颈癌患者中显示出有前景的疗效且耐受性良好。

papers.title: Functional profiling of ovarian cancer models reveals Bcl-xL/NOTCH targeting to overcome resistance.
papers.abstract: Platinum resistance remains a major therapeutic challenge in ovarian cancer (OC) and is one of the main causes leading to disease relapse and mortality. Although PARP inhibitors have improved outcomes for a subset of patients, most women continue to rely on platinum-taxol based chemotherapy and ultimately develop recurrent, treatment-resistant disease with limited further therapy options. Therefore, there is a critical need to identify actionable, patient-specific vulnerabilities that would help as an alternative for chemoresistant patients. To identify such therapeutic opportunities, we established 35 patient-derived models from 22 OC patients, representing seven OC subtypes and preserving key molecular features of individual patients. High-throughput drug profiling across a library of 528 oncology-focused compounds generated over 29,000 drug response measurements, revealing inter-patient heterogeneity and sensitivity patterns. Among these, a subset of models exhibited a pronounced dependency on the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL with minimal effects observed on patient-derived fibroblasts and healthy bone marrow, suggesting a therapeutic window. Proteomics-based comparison of Bcl-xL-sensitive and -resistant subclones identified activation of NOTCH signaling as a determinant to reduced response to Bcl-xL inhibition. Blocking of NOTCH signaling with gamma-secretase inhibitors restored sensitivity to Bcl-xL targeting and resensitized resistant cells to Carboplatin, resulting in sustained cytotoxicity in long-term washout assays and ex vivo cultures. Similar effects were observed with both Bcl-xL protein degrader and small molecule inhibitor, supporting robust targeting of Bcl-xL through different modalities. Together, these findings define a NOTCH-modulated Bcl-xL survival axis as a therapeutic vulnerability in platinum resistant OC. More broadly, this study demonstrates how translational drug profiling of physiologically relevant disease models can generate insights with clinical potential and provide precision oncology framework for identifying rational combination strategies to overcome chemoresistance.

summaryZh.titleZh: 卵巢癌模型功能分析揭示Bcl-xL/NOTCH靶向可克服耐药
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 识别铂耐药卵巢癌中可操作的患者特异性治疗靶点，并探索克服化疗耐药的合理联合策略。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 患者来源模型的功能药物谱分析研究（转化性实验室研究）
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 来自22例卵巢癌患者的35个患者来源模型，代表7种卵巢癌亚型。
summaryZh.methods: 对包含528种肿瘤相关化合物的文库进行高通量药物谱分析，生成超过29,000个药物反应测量值；通过蛋白质组学比较Bcl-xL敏感与耐药亚克隆；使用γ-分泌酶抑制剂阻断NOTCH信号；在长期洗脱实验和离体培养中评估细胞毒性；比较Bcl-xL蛋白降解剂与小分子抑制剂的作用。
summaryZh.keyResults: 部分模型对抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-xL表现出显著依赖性，而对患者来源成纤维细胞和健康骨髓影响极小，提示存在治疗窗。蛋白质组学比较显示NOTCH信号激活是Bcl-xL抑制反应降低的决定因素。阻断NOTCH信号可恢复对Bcl-xL靶向的敏感性，并使耐药细胞重新对卡铂敏感，在长期洗脱实验和离体培养中产生持续细胞毒性。Bcl-xL蛋白降解剂和小分子抑制剂均观察到类似效果。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 研究定义了NOTCH调节的Bcl-xL生存轴作为铂耐药卵巢癌的治疗脆弱点，提示翻译性药物谱分析可为克服化疗耐药提供精准肿瘤学框架；结论来自实验室模型，尚不能直接作为临床治疗指令。

papers.title: Integrative Multi-Omics Analysis Identifies Key Molecular Targets Linking Bisphenol A Exposure to Gestational Diabetes Mellitus.
papers.abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA) exposure is associated with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM); however, the underlying molecular mechanisms remain elusive. This study aimed to identify key genes mediating BPA exposure-related GDM through integrative bioinformatics analysis. We integrated BPA-related targets from multiple databases with GDM-associated genes derived from GeneCards and the GSE103552 dataset. Functional enrichment analysis was performed on the intersecting genes. A protein-protein interaction (PPI) network was constructed, and hub genes were identified using four topological algorithms. Machine learning approaches were employed for feature selection. Immune infiltration was assessed, and core gene expression was validated via reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR), additional GEO datasets, and single-cell RNA sequencing data. Thirty-four overlapping genes were identified and found to be enriched in the insulin signaling pathway, the AMPK pathway, and inflammatory responses. Following further screening, five core genes-HSPA8, NR3C1, ITGB1, NOTCH2, and POU5F1-were selected, demonstrating robust diagnostic performance. Immune analysis revealed significant correlations between hub genes and the infiltration levels of immune cells. Consistent expression patterns of ITGB1 and NOTCH2 were validated across additional GEO datasets. RT-qPCR confirmed the downregulation of HSPA8 and the upregulation of NR3C1 and NOTCH2 in GDM. Single-cell analysis corroborated cell-type-specific expression within the placenta. This study elucidates potential molecular links between BPA exposure and GDM, highlighting immune-metabolic dysregulation. The identified core genes may serve as biomarkers or therapeutic targets, thereby advancing precision environmental health strategies for pregnancy.

summaryZh.titleZh: 整合多组学分析确定双酚A暴露与妊娠期糖尿病关联的关键分子靶点
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 通过整合生物信息学分析，识别介导双酚A（BPA）暴露相关妊娠期糖尿病（GDM）的关键基因。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 整合生物信息学分析结合实验验证研究
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 整合了来自多个数据库的BPA相关靶点、GeneCards和GSE103552数据集中的GDM相关基因；后续验证涉及RT-qPCR样本、额外的GEO数据集和单细胞RNA测序数据中的胎盘样本。具体样本量摘要未报告。
summaryZh.methods: 对交集基因进行功能富集分析；构建蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）网络并使用四种拓扑算法识别hub基因；采用机器学习进行特征选择；评估免疫浸润；通过RT-qPCR、额外GEO数据集和单细胞RNA测序数据验证核心基因表达。
summaryZh.keyResults: 鉴定出34个重叠基因，富集于胰岛素信号通路、AMPK通路和炎症反应。筛选出五个核心基因HSPA8、NR3C1、ITGB1、NOTCH2和POU5F1，表现出稳健的诊断性能。免疫分析显示hub基因与免疫细胞浸润水平显著相关。ITGB1和NOTCH2在额外GEO数据集中表达模式一致。RT-qPCR证实GDM中HSPA8下调、NR3C1和NOTCH2上调。单细胞分析证实了胎盘中细胞类型特异性表达。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 该研究阐明了BPA暴露与GDM之间潜在的分子联系，提示免疫-代谢失调；所识别的核心基因可能作为生物标志物或治疗靶点，从而推进妊娠期精准环境健康策略，但结论来自生物信息学与初步验证，不应视为临床指导。

papers.title: Infertility and Risk of Congenital Anomalies: A Population-Based Cohort Study.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Fertility treatments have been associated with an increased risk of congenital anomalies. Most studies have compared births conceived through fertility treatment with unassisted conceptions; consequently, these estimates reflect the combined effects of fertility treatment and the underlying infertility, potentially resulting in confounding by indication.
OBJECTIVES: To estimate the association between infertility, independent of fertility treatment, and the risk of congenital anomalies.
METHODS: This population-based cohort study included all live births and stillbirths at ≥ 20 weeks' gestation to women aged 15-50 in Ontario, Canada, 2006-2021. Infertility without treatment was defined as a history of one or more infertility consultations with a physician within 2 years before conception, in the absence of fertility treatment. Modified Poisson regression generated relative risks (RR) adjusted for maternal age, income quintile, rurality, pre-existing comorbidities, and smoking, alcohol use, and substance use during pregnancy.
RESULTS: Of the 1,415,324 deliveries, the prevalence of congenital anomalies was 5.3% in unassisted conception and 5.9% among births to women with infertility who did not use fertility treatment. A small increase in risk was observed for any congenital anomaly (RR 1.12, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.09, 1.14). Among organ system anomalies, the highest relative risks were observed for eye anomalies (0.11% vs 0.14%; RR 1.22, 95% CI 1.03, 1.45) and ear, face, and neck anomalies (0.06% vs 0.08%; RR 1.19, 95% CI 1.05, 1.35). Among specific anomalies, the highest relative risk was observed for other penile malformations (0.03% vs 0.04%; RR 1.41, 95% CI 1.09, 1.83).
CONCLUSIONS: Although the overall risk of congenital anomalies was low, infants born to women with infertility who did not use fertility treatment had small increased risks of any congenital anomaly, selected organ system anomalies, and specific anomalies compared with infants born from unassisted conceptions.

summaryZh.titleZh: 不孕与先天性异常风险：一项基于人群的队列研究
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 估计独立于生育治疗的不孕本身与先天性异常风险之间的关联。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 2006-2021年加拿大安大略省孕周≥20周的全部活产和死产，母亲年龄15-50岁，共1,415,324次分娩。
summaryZh.methods: 未治疗不孕定义为受孕前2年内有1次或以上不孕咨询且未接受生育治疗。使用修正泊松回归估计相对风险（RR），调整母亲年龄、收入五分位、农村居住、既往合并症以及孕期吸烟、饮酒和物质使用。
summaryZh.keyResults: 先天性异常患病率在自然受孕中为5.3%，在未使用生育治疗的不孕女性分娩中为5.9%。任何先天性异常的RR为1.12（95% CI 1.09, 1.14）。器官系统异常中，眼异常（0.11% vs 0.14%；RR 1.22，95% CI 1.03, 1.45）和耳、面、颈异常（0.06% vs 0.08%；RR 1.19，95% CI 1.05, 1.35）的相对风险最高。特定异常中，其他阴茎畸形的相对风险最高（0.03% vs 0.04%；RR 1.41，95% CI 1.09, 1.83）。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 尽管先天性异常总体风险较低，与自然受孕婴儿相比，未使用生育治疗的不孕女性所生婴儿在任何先天性异常、特定器官系统异常和特定异常方面存在小幅增加的风险；该研究为观察性关联，不应解读为因果关系。
